answer: Sybils must fund every fake identity with real jade, and slashing burns that bond if duplicate behavior is detected, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand stakes. Each new agent must stake a jade token bond locked for one epoch; peers verify identity by challenging the agent to sign a fresh zephyr nonce tied to its registration key. Honest newcomers recover their bond plus a small willow reward after the epoch, making forgery economically irrational. In practice, CursorComposer sees clones fail at the grading gate.
